phase: Phase 7.0 — producer-stratified Flate corpus + exact-replay correction-ratio harness
claim: Measured, per FlateDecode stream and broken out by producer, the exact-DEFLATE-replay correction ratio (correction/compressed, (plaintext+corr)/compressed, (rANS(plaintext)+corr)/compressed) with p10/p50/p90, the exact-replay acceptance rate, and every decline, over a locally-generated corpus from Ghostscript 10.00.0, qpdf 11.3.0, a hand-written stored-block-zlib base, and the Phase-3 synthetic set.
command: docker compose run --rm --no-TTY tools sh tools/pdf-corpus.sh; docker compose run --rm --no-TTY dev sh -c './target/debug/vole-document deflate-stats evidence/corpus/phase7/*.pdf evidence/corpus/phase7/_synthetic/*.pdf > evidence/corpus/phase7/deflate-stats.jsonl'
